nodes.name: Gathering Root
nodes.purpose: Manages the acquisition and initial onboarding of all actors (workers, clients) and the demand (requests).
nodes.ux_intent: The entire entry into the platform should feel effortless and highly welcoming.
nodes.vertical_notes: Encompasses both the caregiving/nanny and cleaning verticals.

nodes.name: Worker Acquisition
nodes.purpose: Manages the funnel of prospective workers applying to the agency.
nodes.ux_intent: Frictionless, reassuring, and professional path for workers to join the platform.
nodes.vertical_notes: Captures specific credentials for both nanny and cleaner roles.

nodes.name: Worker Apply
nodes.purpose: Allows a visitor/worker to submit an application to join the agency.
nodes.ux_intent: Feels like a friendly conversation, guiding the applicant step-by-step rather than presenting a daunting government-style form.
open_questions: Should we support video intros during application?
nodes.vertical_notes: Nanny: Experience with age groups, care types, DBS, first aid, driving. Cleaning: Property types, specialty, COSHH, equipment.
nodes.case_integration: Early draft of Case profile is generated in the background based on application answers.

nodes.name: Invite Worker
nodes.purpose: Admin sends a unique invitation link to a known prospective worker to bypass cold application steps.
nodes.ux_intent: Worker feels uniquely valued receiving a personalized invite, fast-tracking their onboarding.
nodes.vertical_notes: Useful when agencies recruit specific senior nannies or specialized deep-cleaners directly.

nodes.name: Admin Quick Add Worker
nodes.purpose: Allows an admin to manually and instantly add a worker to the platform.
nodes.ux_intent: Admin can add a worker in 10 seconds while on a phone call.
nodes.vertical_notes: Admins typically use this for offline walk-ins (e.g. 'Jane, nanny, 555-1234').

nodes.name: Review Applicants
nodes.purpose: Displays a queue of all pending worker applications for admin review.
nodes.ux_intent: Clear, skimmable dashboard highlighting key qualifications and missing information at a glance.
nodes.vertical_notes: Highlights DBS/First aid for nannies; COSHH/Equipment for cleaners.

nodes.name: Vet Worker
nodes.purpose: Admin checks credentials, notes interview outcomes, and verifies references.
nodes.ux_intent: Structured and seamless data entry for admins to confidently check off requirements.
nodes.vertical_notes: Strict DBS and first-aid verification for nannies. Address and right-to-work for all.

nodes.name: Activate Worker
nodes.purpose: Transitions a vetted applicant into the active worker pool, allowing them to take jobs.
nodes.ux_intent: A celebratory moment; worker receives a warm welcome message and access to their profile.
nodes.vertical_notes: Once active, they can be matched to nanny shifts or cleaning jobs.
nodes.case_integration: Worker profile seeded into Case on activation.

nodes.name: Reject Worker
nodes.purpose: Declines a worker application and archives their data appropriately.
nodes.ux_intent: Respectful, clear communication with minimal admin effort.
nodes.vertical_notes: Often due to expired DBS or lack of required experience.

nodes.name: Share Worker Profile
nodes.purpose: Generates a public, shareable link of the worker's best assignments and skills for families/clients.
nodes.ux_intent: Empowers the worker to market themselves with a beautiful, professional digital resume.
open_questions: How much personal contact info is exposed on the public link?
nodes.vertical_notes: Nannies share a showcase of their childcare experience; cleaners highlight reliability and specialty cleans.
nodes.case_integration: Directly integrates with the Case Portfolio app to render the public view.

nodes.name: Client Acquisition
nodes.purpose: Manages client accounts, registrations, and anonymous identities.
nodes.ux_intent: Frictionless onboarding for families and businesses seeking help.
nodes.vertical_notes: Caters to families needing care and homeowners/offices needing cleaning.

nodes.name: Client Self-Register
nodes.purpose: Client creates a full account for recurring services and auto-invoicing.
nodes.ux_intent: Quick, straightforward account creation. Just enough info to get started securely.
nodes.vertical_notes: Families set up home address; commercial cleaning clients set up office addresses and billing contacts.

nodes.name: Admin Add Client
nodes.purpose: Admin manually registers a client who called in or walked in.
nodes.ux_intent: Lightning fast data entry for the admin while on a live call.
nodes.vertical_notes: Common for older clients requesting elderly care or simple cleaning services via phone.

nodes.name: Anonymous Client Session
nodes.purpose: Tracks a visitor who is booking a service without creating an account.
nodes.ux_intent: Zero barriers to entry. The visitor feels trusted and not forced into a commitment.
nodes.vertical_notes: Perfect for one-off emergency nanny cover or a single end-of-tenancy clean.

nodes.name: Upgrade Anonymous Client
nodes.purpose: Converts an anonymous session/booking into a full client account seamlessly.
nodes.ux_intent: 'Since you already booked, just set a password to save your details for next time.'
nodes.vertical_notes: Often happens when a family realizes they want the same nanny again next week.

nodes.name: View Client Profile
nodes.purpose: Allows a registered client to view and edit their own account details, addresses, and payment info.
nodes.ux_intent: Simple, centralized hub where the client feels in control of their data.
nodes.vertical_notes: Families manage kids' allergies here; offices manage access codes.

nodes.name: Demand Capture
nodes.purpose: Captures and categorizes all requests for services (jobs, shifts, contracts).
nodes.ux_intent: Making a request should be as easy as sending a text message with exactly what you need.
nodes.vertical_notes: Handles one-offs, recurring, long-term, and emergency requests across caregiving and cleaning.

nodes.name: Submit Request
nodes.purpose: Registered client submits a standard request for a nanny or cleaning service.
nodes.ux_intent: Intuitive flow that auto-fills known details and only asks for job-specific requirements.
nodes.vertical_notes: Nanny: 'Toddler, needs meal prep.' Cleaning: '3 bed semi, regular clean.'

nodes.name: Anonymous Submit Request
nodes.purpose: Allows a visitor to request a service instantly providing only essential contact and job info.
nodes.ux_intent: Under 2 minutes to request a nanny. 'Just tell us who, when, and where to text you.'
open_questions: How do we handle spam from anonymous requests?
nodes.vertical_notes: Very common for last-minute emergency childcare or immediate end-of-tenancy cleans.

nodes.name: Admin Submit Request
nodes.purpose: Admin logs a service request on behalf of a client calling over the phone.
nodes.ux_intent: Optimized for speed and shorthand so admin can type as the client speaks.
nodes.vertical_notes: Often used to capture complex bespoke care requirements.

nodes.name: Recurring Request
nodes.purpose: Client sets up a repeating schedule (e.g., every Tuesday) for care or cleaning.
nodes.ux_intent: 'Set it and forget it.' Peace of mind that help will arrive predictably.
nodes.vertical_notes: Weekly cleaner, or after-school nanny every M/W/F.

nodes.name: Long-Term Job Request
nodes.purpose: Captures a request for a permanent or extended placement (e.g., live-in nanny).
nodes.ux_intent: Feels consultative and thorough, acknowledging the importance of a long-term match.
nodes.vertical_notes: First-class support for live-in nannies, permanent household staff, or dedicated daily office cleaners.

nodes.name: Emergency Request
nodes.purpose: Client requests urgent, same-day or within-hours coverage.
nodes.ux_intent: Provides immediate reassurance. 'We are on it right now.' Visually prioritized in the UI.
nodes.vertical_notes: Nanny called in sick, need cover in 2 hours; or emergency bio-hazard/flood clean.

nodes.name: Cancel Request
nodes.purpose: Client or anon cancels an outstanding service request before it is fulfilled.
nodes.ux_intent: No guilt, 1-click cancellation. Instantly updates the system to stop searching.
open_questions: What is the cut-off time for penalty-free cancellation?
nodes.vertical_notes: Cancellations of caregiving might require notifying the matched worker instantly.

nodes.name: View Request Status
nodes.purpose: Allows clients (including anons via magic link) to check the real-time status of their booking.
nodes.ux_intent: Like tracking a pizza delivery: totally transparent, 'Searching for your nanny...' -> 'Found!'
nodes.vertical_notes: Particularly crucial for emergency nanny requests to reduce parent anxiety.

nodes.name: Resubmit Request
nodes.purpose: Allows a client to duplicate, edit, and resubmit a past or cancelled request.
nodes.ux_intent: 'I need the exact same thing as last time, but tomorrow instead.' 1-click reorder.
nodes.vertical_notes: Great for recurring but irregular cleaning needs.
